verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or hands-on account of the actual installer/dual-boot/replace-OS process (partitioning, live USB, Anaconda installer, etc.); it only covers desktop features and general community sentiment (e.g., fedora-comm-10 discusses a VirtualBox VM install, not replacing a host OS). Missing for 10: installer walkthrough, dual-boot/replace-OS instructions, first-party or independent evidence of a successful bare-metal switch.
